items.title: Determination of a Vector from its Rectangular Components (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Determination of a Vector from its Rectangular Components: a main subheading of 2.2 Vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 23-25.

blocks.text: Agar kisi vector ke rectangular components diye hon (Fig. 2.1), to Pythagorean theorem se vector ki magnitude nikal sakte hain.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Component nikalna: Ax = A cos θ aur Ay = A sin θ. Wapas vector banana: magnitude A = √(Ax² + Ay²) aur direction θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax). Example: 20 N ki force 60° par ho to Fx = 20 cos 60° = 10 N aur Fy = 20 sin 60° = 17.3 N.

blocks.title: Example 2.1
blocks.problem: Barabar magnitude wali do forces ke darmiyan angle nikalein jab un ke resultant ki magnitude bhi har ek force ke barabar ho.
steps:
Farz karein F₁ aur F₂ ke darmiyan angle θ hai aur F₁ x-axis ke saath hai. Resultant ka x-component:
Rx = F₁ cos 0° + F₂ cos θ
Rx = F₁ + F₂ cos θ (kyun ke cos 0° = 1)

Resultant ka y-component:
Ry = F₁ sin 0° + F₂ sin θ
Ry = F₂ sin θ (kyun ke sin 0° = 0)
Question ke mutabiq R = F₁ = F₂ = F

Is liye F² = (F + F cos θ)² + (F sin θ)²
F² = F² + F²cos²θ + 2F² cos θ + F² sin²θ
Dono taraf se F² kat jata hai: 0 = 2F² cos θ + F² (cos²θ + sin²θ)
cos²θ + sin²θ = 1, is liye 0 = 2F² cos θ + F²
F² se divide (taqseem) karein: cos θ = -0.5
blocks.answer: θ = cos⁻¹(-0.5) = 120°. Yani do barabar forces 120° par hon to un ka resultant bhi utna hi hota hai.

blocks.caption: Vector ke components
rows: Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ

blocks.prompt: 20 N ki force horizontal (leti hui seedhi line) se 60° oopar lagti hai. Is ke rectangular components nikalein, phir un se wapas magnitude aur direction nikal kar dekhein.

items: Vector: magnitude aur direction dono (displacement, velocity, acceleration, force); arrow se dikhate hain, bold letter ya letter par arrow se likhte hain.
Rectangular components: A⃗ = A⃗x + A⃗y, Ax = A cos θ, Ay = A sin θ; wapas: A = √(Ax² + Ay²), θ = tan⁻¹(Ay/Ax).
Example 2.1: do barabar forces ka resultant bhi utna hi ho to un ke darmiyan angle 120° hai.
